observed_problem: AUD-019 generalized Quality and Publication Candidate PDF authority to support GitHub Actions artifacts, but Production State semantic validation still interprets Publication Candidate pdf.path as a repository-local file and requires that file to exist after Publication Preview approval.
expected_behavior: Production State must validate Publication Preview authority using the same durable PDF authority semantics as the Quality/Publication layer: repository-backed PDFs are re-opened and hashed locally, while Actions-backed PDFs are validated structurally and by the exact authority embedded in the immutable Candidate/Approval records without requiring an ephemeral materialized PDF in later checkouts.
actual_behavior: validate_state_semantics calls repo_local_path on candidate.pdf.path and requires is_file()/sha256_file equality for every approved Publication Preview. For GITHUB_ACTIONS_ARTIFACT, pdf.path is an artifact member such as main.pdf, so an otherwise valid exact-byte Preview approval fails State validation after the local build artifact is gone.
production_workaround: External W33/SP001 production remains blocked until the coherent Core v2 candidate is Human-reviewed and merged; Production State now consumes the same durable PDF authority semantics and the integrated Human-Gate regression passes.
improvement_action: Make Production State Publication Preview validation branch on Candidate pdf.storage, preserving local byte revalidation for REPOSITORY_FILE and validating the durable Actions authority shape/identity for GITHUB_ACTIONS_ARTIFACT; add an integrated State/Human-Gate regression where the local PDF is removed before approval.
